{{See also|Firedust Dagger}} {{Infobox/Weapon |rarity = r |slayer_level_requirement = Blaze Slayer 2 |damage = +90 |strength = +45 |crit_damage = +15% |enchant = y |reforge = y |auctionable = y |museum = y |museum_xp = 6 |museum_category = combat |upgrades_to = Mawdredge Dagger |raw_materials = *800 Sulphur *128 Derelict Ashe *640 Red Sand *640 Mycelium *2560 Magma Cream *2560 Glowstone Dust *2560 Nether Wart *2560 Blaze Rod *1 Stick |bazaar_not_including = [[Stick]] |mat_cost_bazaar = *5 ENCHANTED_SULPHUR *1 MOLTEN_POWDER |id = MAWDUST_DAGGER }} The '''Twilight Dagger''' is a {{Rare}} [[Sword]]. It is unlocked at {{Coll|Blaze Slayer II}}. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Blaze Slayer 2}} |A1 = |B1 = Enchanted Sulphur, 5 |C1 = |A2 = |B2 = Molten Powder |C2 = |A3 = |B3 = Stick |C3 = |Output = Twilight Dagger }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Sword |name = Twilight Dagger |rarity = r |damage = 90 |crit_damage = 15 |strength = 45 |special_effect = Deal {{Red|1.5x}} damage to {{mt|Infernal}} mobs.
Deal {{Red|1.2x}} damage to {{mt|Skeletal}} mobs.
Gain {{stat|combat wisdom|+15}} against {{mt|Infernal}} mobs. |item_ability_name = Attunement |item_ability_description = Swap between {{White|Spirit}} and {{Cyan|Crystal}} mode in order to attack through Hellion Shields. |item_ability_activation = On Right Click |item_ability_name2 = Wraith Drain |item_ability_description2 = On hit, heal for {{Red|200}} + {{Red|4%}}{{HP}} after {{Green|6s}} if the Hellion Shield has switched attunement. }} The '''Twilight Dagger''' deals {{Red|1.5x}} damage to {{mt|Infernal}} mobs and {{Red|1.2x}} damage to {{mt|Skeletal}} mobs. Additionally, it provides {{Stat|combat wisdom|+15}} against {{mt|Infernal}} mobs. The '''Twilight Dagger''' has {{Green|2}} abilities: * {{AN|Attunement}} allows the wielder to swap between '''Spirit''' and {{Aqua|'''Crystal'''}} attunements in order to attack through the {{MobSprite|Inferno Demonlord}}'s {{AN|Hellion Shield}} ability. When switching attunement, the '''Twilight Dagger''' changes appearance from a {{Item|Iron Sword|link=}} to a {{Item|Golden Sword|link=}}. * {{AN|Wraith Drain}} allows the wielder to heal {{Stat|hp|200}} + {{Stat|hp|4%|icononly=yes}} after {{Green|6s}} upon hit if the {{AN|Hellion Shield}} has switched attunement. === Crafting === {{Crafting Usage}} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/Mar 21|link=none|[[File:Twilight Dagger (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Twilight Dagger'''.}} {{History|2024/Nov 25|link=none|'''Twilight Dagger''' now grants {{Stat|Combat Wisdom|+15}} against Blazes.}} {{History|2026/Jun 24|[[File:Twilight Dagger (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Twilight Dagger''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|[[File:Twilight Dagger (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Twilight Dagger'''.}} {{History|0.20.9|'''Twilight Dagger''' now grants {{Stat|Combat Wisdom|+15}} against Blazes.}} {{History|0.23.3|'''Firedust Dagger''' perks changed to affect {{mt|Infernal}} and {{mt|Wither}} mobs.}} {{History|0.26|[[File:Twilight Dagger (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Twilight Dagger''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Slayer/Blaze}} [[Category:Daggers]]
